relationships.subject: NaTx36
relationships.evidence_quote: Toxin NaTx36 significantly decreased OtNaV1.8 Na+ current density from 217.5 ± 27.83 pA/pF to 57.82 ± 10.47 pA/pF (10 μg/ml, n = 9 cells, p < 0.05) (Figure 2A).

relationships.subject: NaTx36
relationships.evidence_quote: Neither 100 nM nor 1.0 µM NaTx36 inhibited hNav1.8.

relationships.subject: DI S4 voltage sensor R215
relationships.evidence_quote: NaTx36 (100 nM) failed to inhibit TTX-R Na+ currents recorded from the DI voltage sensor mutant (R215G) channels.

key_findings: Synthetic scorpion peptide NaTx36 inhibits grasshopper mouse NaV1.8 (IC50 0.68 uM) and shifts fast and slow inactivation to hyperpolarized potentials, but does not inhibit human NaV1.8.
The DI S4 first gating charge (R215) and DII SS2-S6 acidic residue (E862) are critical for NaTx36 inhibition.
